offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription medicines for opioid use disorder and related addiction and mental health conditions. Sells mainly to wholesalers and specialty pharmacies, which supply prescribers, pharmacies and healthcare providers. Relies on contract manufacturers for production.

primary_products.value: buprenorphine/naloxone sublingual film; extended-release buprenorphine injection; long-acting injectable for schizophrenia

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical wholesalers, specialty pharmacies and distributors supplying clinics and prescribers; B2G: government health programs and public payers such as Medicaid

end_markets.value: healthcare; addiction treatment; behavioral health; mental health

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription drugs sold to wholesalers and specialty pharmacies, net of rebates

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets branded drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to wholesalers and pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Europe, Canada, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: opioid use disorder treatments and related central nervous system injectables

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: wholesalers and specialty distributors; third-party retail: retail and specialty pharmacies dispensing to patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs requiring FDA and EMA approval, DEA controlled substance rules, REMS programs
